findings.evidence: `DegreeImage.lean:7` imports `TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.DegreeSplitting`, while the declarations at lines 67, 80, 86 use only `weightedDegree`/`degree` from `WeilDivisor.lean`, and lines 98, 112, 131, 155 use only `weightedDegreeClass`/`picZero` from `Principal.lean`; the first actual splitting references are `weightedDegreeClass_surjective` at line 121 and `degreeSection` at line 186.
findings.fix: Move the raw divisor-degree range lemmas to `WeilDivisor.lean` or an early degree file, move the general `weightedDegreeClass`/`Cl(X)/Pic⁰` quotient facts to a file importing only `Principal` (or the existing `PicZeroQuotient` layer), and leave only the weight-one corollaries using `degreeSection`/`weightedDegreeClass_surjective` after `DegreeSplitting`.
findings.issue: The whole file publicly imports `DegreeSplitting`, but `weightedDegree_range`, `degree_surjective`, `degree_range_eq_top`, `weightedDegreeClass_range`, `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top`, and the non-weight-one quotient equivalences do not use the splitting API and belong before it.

summary: The new material is mathematically in the right WeilDivisor/class-group area, but the file puts general degree-image and quotient API behind the later `DegreeSplitting` layer. Split the layer-independent declarations earlier so users do not import the weight-one splitting theory for basic range/quotient facts.
